name: Canonical MCP external-source integrations (implementation / governance / storage)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-01 (via 0.5.0 proposal 9d8451df0): 'promote integration framework to CTO and let's have them make a canonical NFRA_INTEGRATIONS project and we get a process in place for implementation, governance, and storage.' The canonical project-of-record for external-source MCP integrations on the Opal gateway. Born because the gateway generalized from M365-Graph-only to a registrable multi-source model (YCharts landed 2026-07-01, dormant; kuzu/nessie/iceberg charted next) -- the framework EXISTS but is gateway-local+informal, governance is ad-hoc, storage/bucket/dependency schema is convention-not-canonical. THREE PILLARS: P1 IMPLEMENTATION = promote infra/aws/ec2/m365-mcp-gateway/INTEGRATION_FRAMEWORK.md (0.7.0 v1: IntegrationSpec schema + app/integrations/<id>/ layout + registry.py + run_integration_tool audited path + 5-step add-process + fail-closed enablement + 3 AuthKinds DELEGATED_USER/SHARED_SECRET/NONE) to docs/architecture standard. P2 GOVERNANCE = codify the per-integration CTO arch-gate (3 axes: new egress hosts-allowlist + new tool surface on the SEV1 box + secret/IAM), wire spec.min_tier to the LIVE SCTY_MCPGUARD guard, read-only-by-default, fail-closed-enable-is-a-deploy-not-a-flip, Third-Party-Data-Standard creds, ownership (gateway-owner-of-record + author-build-pen + CTO-gate + CVO-live-cert). P3 STORAGE (net-new, 0.5.0 drafts) = canonical code-location/tool_prefix + dependency model (gateway-venv vs pipeline-Lambda-layer, document both) + one-SM-secret-per-integration + the FIRM-SEPARATION invariant on integration-persisted data (must not cross firm buckets, rule 13) + hosts egress-allowlist. Governing principle (Andrew): read-only, compartmentalized to key data sources. PRD docs/architecture/NFRA_INTEGRATIONS_PRD.md.

prds.label: INTEGRATIONS PRD v1.0 (CTO-authored, promotes 0.7.0 framework v1)

phase: Phase 0: PRD complete (CTO 2026-07-01), promotes INTEGRATION_FRAMEWORK.md v1. P3 storage-schema draft delegated to 0.5.0_AE_OpalETL (folds on RAVC). Awaiting COO decomposition. First-wave: P1 (formalize the framework standard + mandated checklist, CloudOps/AE+CTO), P2 (codify the repeatable arch-gate + wire min_tier to the live SCTY guard, CTO+AE+CVO), P3 (net-new storage/dependency/bucket schema, 0.5.0 draft->CTO fold).
blocking: COO TO decomposition + GO. P3 storage detail pending 0.5.0's draft. Leash (every TO): read-only-by-default (mutating = explicit escalation, separately gated); fail-closed enablement (dormant until enabled, enabling is an arch-gated deploy never a flip); per-integration CTO arch-gate (egress+tool-surface+secret/IAM); SCTY min_tier enforced; firm-separation on any persisted integration data; Third-Party-Data-Standard credentials.
pipeline: n/a (platform standard: MCP gateway integrations governance)
depends_on_note: Promotes 0.7.0's gateway-local INTEGRATION_FRAMEWORK.md v1 (YCharts = first integration, dormant). SCTY_MCPGUARD (tier gate) went LIVE 2026-07-01 -> P2 wires spec.min_tier enforcement to the deployed guard. NFRA_OPLMCP = the gateway host; NFRA_MSGRAPH = the DELEGATED_USER native source the framework generalizes; SCTY_PREMCP = the egress/SSRF perimeter the hosts-allowlist pairs with; Third-Party Data Standard = credentials; DATA_PLATFORM/rule-13 = the firm-separation bucket convention P3 canonicalizes for integration data. YCharts was excluded from the 2026-07-01 SCTY deploy (dormant + un-arch-gated) -- this project is the gate it deploys through.
